G+ iSmart 3-in-1 Wireless Charger for iPhone, AirPods & Apple Watch

The G+ iSmart 3-in-1 Wireless Charger is a premium all-in-one charging solution designed for Apple users who demand speed, safety, and convenience. Built with MagSafe Certified Qi2 Technology, this advanced wireless charger delivers fast, stable, and efficient charging for your iPhone, AirPods, and Apple Watch—all at the same time.

Compatible with Apple iPhone 16, 15, 14, 13, and 12 series, the G+ iSmart charger eliminates cable clutter while maintaining optimal charging alignment through powerful magnetic locking. Whether placed on your bedside table, office desk, or travel bag, this wireless charging station keeps your Apple ecosystem powered up effortlessly.

Fast Charging with MagSafe Certified Qi2 Technology

Powered by the latest Qi2 wireless charging technology, the G+ iSmart 3-in-1 Wireless Charger ensures faster charging speeds and improved energy efficiency compared to standard Qi chargers. The MagSafe certified design guarantees precise alignment with your iPhone for consistent power delivery, reduced heat generation, and enhanced battery protection.

From quick top-ups to overnight charging, this wireless charger for iPhone delivers reliable performance without compromising device safety. Integrated smart chip protection safeguards against over-voltage, over-current, overheating, and short circuits.

One Charger for iPhone, AirPods & Apple Watch

Simplify your charging routine with a single device. The G+ iSmart 3-in-1 wireless charging station is engineered to charge:

  • iPhone with MagSafe wireless fast charging
  • AirPods with wireless charging case
  • Apple Watch with dedicated magnetic charging pad

This Apple 3-in-1 wireless charger supports simultaneous charging without power drops, making it ideal for daily use at home or work.

Wide Compatibility with Apple Devices

Designed for maximum compatibility, the G+ iSmart charger works seamlessly with:

  • iPhone 16 / 16 Plus / 16 Pro / 16 Pro Max
  • iPhone 15, 14, 13, and 12 series
  • AirPods Pro, AirPods (2nd & 3rd Gen) with wireless case
  • Apple Watch Series Ultra, SE, and Series 1–9

Whether you’re upgrading to the latest iPhone or using earlier MagSafe-enabled models, this Qi2 wireless charger ensures future-ready performance.

Premium Design Built for Everyday Use

Crafted with a sleek, minimalist profile, the G+ iSmart 3-in-1 Wireless Charger complements modern interiors while saving valuable desk space. The anti-slip base and durable materials provide long-lasting stability, while the foldable structure makes it travel-friendly.

Soft LED indicators display charging status without disturbing your sleep, making it an ideal wireless charging stand for bedside use.

Key Features & Benefits

  • MagSafe Certified Qi2 fast wireless charging
  • 3-in-1 wireless charger for iPhone, AirPods & Apple Watch
  • Compatible with iPhone 16/15/14/13/12 series
  • Simultaneous charging without power loss
  • Advanced safety protection with smart chipset
  • Compact, foldable, and travel-friendly design
  • Heat control for extended battery health

Why Choose G+ iSmart?

The G+ iSmart 3-in-1 Wireless Charger combines cutting-edge charging technology with premium build quality to deliver a superior Apple charging experience. Unlike ordinary wireless chargers, it is optimized for speed, alignment, and long-term reliability—making it a smart investment for Apple users. Upgrade your charging setup today with a MagSafe compatible Qi2 wireless charger that keeps all your essential Apple devices powered, organized, and ready to go.
